title: The Hadza Carry About 730 Gut Bacteria Species
hook: Modern diets look advanced. The Hadza carry about 730 gut bacteria species.
closing: Civilization made our food safer and our guts emptier.
question: How much fiber did you eat today?

segments.say: The Hadza of Tanzania carry about 730 gut bacteria species. The average American has fewer than half that.
The secret is fiber. The Hadza eat 150 grams a day, ten times the average American.
The CDC says a third of US antibiotic prescriptions aren't even necessary, and each one can wipe out gut diversity.
